exchange-router: Entry point for all trading operations: opening and closing positions, placing and cancelling orders.
synthetics-reader: Market snapshots including prices, open interest, funding rates, and oracle state.
data-store: Persistent storage for market configuration, pool state, and position collateral.
market-factory: Factory for deploying and configuring synthetic trading markets.
deposit-handler: Executes liquidity deposit requests and mints GM pool tokens.
withdrawal-handler: Executes liquidity withdrawal requests and burns GM pool tokens.
order-vault: Holds collateral until an order is filled or cancelled, protecting against withdrawal during execution.
referral-storage: Stores referral codes, trader-affiliate relationships, and tier discount structures.
oracle: On-chain oracle contract feeding verified asset prices to Reader view functions.
order-handler: Executes market, limit, and trigger orders dispatched from the exchange router.
test-faucet: Testnet utility to distribute test tokens to new traders.
test-token: Testnet representative Stellar asset (TUSDC); all test token contracts share this interface.
token-twbtc: Testnet Wrapped Bitcoin (TWBTC) Stellar Asset Contract.
token-teth: Testnet Wrapped Ether (TETH) Stellar Asset Contract.
token-txlm: Testnet Stellar Lumens (TXLM) Stellar Asset Contract.
market-token-twbtc-tusdc: Market token for the TWBTC/TUSDC synthetic liquidity pool.
market-token-teth-tusdc: Market token for the TETH/TUSDC synthetic liquidity pool.
market-token-txlm-tusdc: Market token for the TXLM/TUSDC synthetic liquidity pool.
glv-router: Generalized liquidity vault for multi-pool liquidity provision and risk management.
staking-router: Staking router contract for token staking and protocol yield distribution.
vesting-router: Vesting router contract managing token vesting schedules.
